title: What actually happens when you call an API
question: What actually happens when you call an API?
summary: One request, one response, and the parts of each that decide what you get back. Ends with you writing the server half: a validator on the response, and a 304 for the poll that finds nothing new.

steps.note: Start here. Everything after this hour is a variation on it.
The metadata that decides what the request actually does.
